products.title: Overhook From Everywhere by Adele Fornarino
products.body:
Unlock the power of the overhook with Overhook From Everywhere, the groundbreaking BJJ instructional by two-time ADCC champion Adele Fornarino

  • Widely regarded as one of the best female competitors in the world, Adele breaks down her signature overhook strategies that will transform your game from every position
  • This comprehensive series teaches you how to dominate with the overhook — not just as a defensive tool, but as a dynamic weapon to attack, submit, sweep, and control your opponent.
  • Whether you’re looking to improve your standing clinch, guard passing, or top control, Adele’s expert guidance will help you harness the subtle leverage and control of the overhook to win matches consistently.
  • Step into a new realm of grappling efficiency with techniques crafted from the highest levels of competition — designed for practitioners of all skill levels who want to elevate their BJJ with a fresh and powerful approach.



Check Out a Free Sample:

What Will You Learn?

Unlock the power of the overhook with Overhook From Everywhere, the groundbreaking BJJ instructional by two-time ADCC champion Adele Fornarino. Widely regarded as one of the best female competitors in the world, Adele breaks down her signature overhook strategies that will transform your game from every position. This comprehensive series teaches you how to dominate with the overhook — not just as a defensive tool, but as a dynamic weapon to attack, submit, sweep, and control your opponent.

Whether you’re looking to improve your standing clinch, guard passing, or top control, Adele’s expert guidance will help you harness the subtle leverage and control of the overhook to win matches consistently. Step into a new realm of grappling efficiency with techniques crafted from the highest levels of competition — designed for practitioners of all skill levels who want to elevate their BJJ with a fresh and powerful approach.

Bullet Points

  • Learn from a legend: Instruction by Adele Fornarino, 2x ADCC champion and one of the world’s top female grapplers

  • Focus on the overhook: Master the use of the overhook instead of the traditional underhook to gain superior control and leverage

  • Complete positional coverage: Techniques from standing clinch, guard, half guard, top control, and more — attack from every angle

  • Attack, submit, sweep & control: Detailed drills and sequences to turn the overhook into an offensive weapon, not just a defensive hold

  • Suitable for all levels: Clear step-by-step instruction designed for beginners to advanced practitioners looking to diversify their game

  • Competitive tested: Techniques proven at the highest level of grappling competition, refined by a multiple-time ADCC medalist

  • Expand your grappling toolbox: Add a unique and highly effective set of moves to your BJJ arsenal for better match-winning opportunities

products.title: Overhook Closed Guard by Adele Fornarino
products.body:
Two-time ADCC Champion Adele Fornarino unveils her signature Overhook Closed Guard system—a brutally effective submission series built around control, timing, and relentless finishing. 

  • Known for one of the highest submission rates in the sport, Adele shows how to transform a simple overhook into a submission factory from bottom closed guard.
  • Whether you're a beginner looking for high-percentage options or a seasoned grappler wanting to sharpen your finishing tools, this instructional will level up your guard with proven techniques used at the highest levels of competition.

  • Adele’s system is built around control first, then submission—making it ideal for practitioners who want both safety and attack power from closed guard.



Check Out a Free Sample:

What will You Learn?

🔒 Overhook Closed Guard by Adele Fornarino

Master the Closed Guard Game with One of the World’s Most Dangerous Submission Artists

Two-time ADCC Champion Adele Fornarino unveils her signature Overhook Closed Guard system—a brutally effective submission series built around control, timing, and relentless finishing. Known for one of the highest submission rates in the sport, Adele shows how to transform a simple overhook into a submission factory from bottom closed guard.

Whether you're a beginner looking for high-percentage options or a seasoned grappler wanting to sharpen your finishing tools, this instructional will level up your guard with proven techniques used at the highest levels of competition.

✅ What You’ll Learn:

  • Overhook Control Fundamentals – Learn how to establish and maintain a tight overhook that neutralizes posture and opens up attacks.

  • Submission Chains – Armbar, triangle, omoplata, and more—all flowing directly from the overhook position.

  • Sweeps and Transitions – Combine threat with movement to keep opponents guessing and off-balance.

  • High-Percentage Setups – Simple yet surgical entries designed to work in both gi and no-gi.

  • Competition-Tested Concepts – Techniques Adele used to dominate the world stage with unmatched submission precision.

🧠 Why This Series Works:

Adele’s system is built around control first, then submission—making it ideal for practitioners who want both safety and attack power from closed guard. With clear instruction and battle-proven sequences, this course gives you a full roadmap to one of the most underused but dangerous guard variations in modern jiu-jitsu.

What Exactly Do You Get?

  • Overhook Key Concepts
  • When To Use The Underhook
  • Closed Guard Establishing Overhook

  • Triangle Troubleshooting
  • Meanest Triangle In Jiu Jitsu  

Part 2

  • Armbar
  • Flower Sweep Armbar
  • Slippery Fish Armbar From Stack
  • Omoplata

  • Omoplata Double Roll
  • Bonus Gogoplata
  • Belly Down Armbar From Overhook  

Part 3

  • Sweeps Scissor Sweep
  • Scissor Sweep Partner Posts
  • Scissor Sweep Variation
  • Overhook Armbar From Mount
  • Flower Sweep
  • Mir Lock
  • Arm Drag To The Back
  • Combining It All Together
  • Outro

products.title: Closed Guard Fundamentals by Adele Fornarino
products.body:
Unlock the secrets of one of the most dominant positions in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with Closed Guard Fundamentals, taught by 2x ADCC World Champion Adele Fornarino—one of the most technically refined grapplers of her generation.

  • This instructional breaks down the closed guard like never before, with Adele’s precise, principle-driven approach to control, timing, and high-percentage attacks

  • Whether you’re a beginner laying your foundation or an advanced player tightening your game, Adele’s systematic teaching brings clarity to a classic position often misunderstood and underutilized.

  • Master the fundamentals that win at the highest level of competition—from posture-breaking and grip domination to sweeps, submissions, and transitions that actually work against elite resistance



What Will You Learn?

Unlock the secrets of one of the most dominant positions in Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu with Closed Guard Fundamentals, taught by 2x ADCC World Champion Adele Fornarino—one of the most technically refined grapplers of her generation.

This instructional breaks down the closed guard like never before, with Adele’s precise, principle-driven approach to control, timing, and high-percentage attacks. Whether you’re a beginner laying your foundation or an advanced player tightening your game, Adele’s systematic teaching brings clarity to a classic position often misunderstood and underutilized.

Master the fundamentals that win at the highest level of competition—from posture-breaking and grip domination to sweeps, submissions, and transitions that actually work against elite resistance.

What You’ll Learn:

  • 🔒 Foundational Closed Guard Concepts – Build your game on strong, technical fundamentals that scale with your level.

  • 🧠 Posture-Breaking Mastery – Learn the subtle mechanics to disrupt even the most disciplined opponents.

  • 🕸️ Grip Strategies That Control the Fight – Dominate tempo with intelligent, layered grip work.

  • 🌀 Sweep Systems That Translate to All Levels – From scissor to hip bump, understand when and why each works.

  • ⚔️ Submission Chains That Force Reactions – Armbar, triangle, and omoplata attacks that work together seamlessly.

  • 🧭 Positional Navigation – Transition smoothly to back takes, mount, and other dominant positions without giving up control.

  • 🏆 Competition-Proven Details – The exact techniques Adele used on the biggest no-gi stages in the world.
